text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Training in preparation for the Kyodo
News Hai. Duramente ran with a fierce 
intensity, looking as if she was pushing 
herself to her absolute limits all the
way through.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
It's likely due to her obsession with 
pulling away. However, that running style 
takes a heavy physical toll.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
So for the Kyodo News Hai, the Trainer 
gave her the objective of running while 
keeping herself calm.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente was aware that she tended to
get 
overly worked up when it came to races. 
Accepting her flaws, she headed into the 
race.
